evd_title: ChatGPT and human evaluators differed by mean 4.92% in overall compliance score on CONSORT-A
finding: ChatGPT and human evaluators differed by mean 4.92% in overall compliance score on CONSORT-A
P: 30 implant-dentistry RCT abstracts (Menne, Pandis & Faggion 2021 SR)
I: ChatGPT GPT-3.5 (no version pin), zero-shot fixed prompt with CONSORT-A item definitions; single run
C: 2 clinician reviewers (consensus >=80%, then one reviewer solo)
O: Bland-Altman mean difference in overall compliance score % (human - ChatGPT) = 4.92% (printed 95% CI 0.62%, 0.37% likely typo)
